policy: Fixed nonparametric comparator:most recent30 positive-minute points observations in prior365days,minimum10;48h availability lag. Beta(2,2) smoothing on conditional exact-line OVER frequency. No scaling,model fitting,outcome threshold tuning,side flipping or50/50 selection quota. Existing baseline eligible-input gate retained.
limitations: Saved outcomes already inspected;retrospective model development,not independent validation.
Empirical player outcomes omit pregame injury/rotation/opponent changes;not a validated recommendation.
DNP omitted only from outcome sample;original lagged role gating retains full participation history.
Probabilities exclude empirical pushes from conditional win frequency. Exact sportsbook prices unavailable;no ROI claim.
